subject: Pricing for a company website
body: Hi SafeX team, I run a mid-sized logistics firm and we need a new corporate website with about 15 pages and a client portal. Could you send me an idea of what something like this would cost and how you structure your pricing? Thanks, Daniel

subject: Quote request - ecommerce store
body: Hello, we are launching an online clothing store and need a full ecommerce build with payment integration. Please share a detailed quote and estimated timeline. Regards Aisha

subject: Do you do penetration testing?
body: Good afternoon. We are a fintech startup and our investors are asking for a security audit. Do you offer penetration testing and vulnerability assessments? What does the process look like? Marcus

subject: Website is down since this morning
body: Our website that your team built has been showing a 502 error since about 8am today. This is urgent as we are getting customer complaints. Please look into it immediately. Priya

subject: Very disappointed with the delay
body: I was told the app would be delivered by the 30th and it is now two weeks past that with no update from anyone. This is not acceptable and I would like an explanation. Tom Whitfield

subject: Internship opportunities
body: Hi, I am a final year computer science student and I came across your skill development program. Are you accepting interns for the next cycle and how do I apply? Thank you, Sara

subject: Can we schedule a call this week?
body: Hello, I would like to discuss a potential project with your team. Are you available for a 30 minute call on Wednesday or Thursday afternoon? Kevin

subject: Invoice 4471 - double charged
body: Hi, I noticed invoice 4471 was charged twice to our card on the 3rd. Could you check and process a refund for the duplicate? Lucia

subject: Partnership proposal
body: Greetings, our agency in Dubai works with clients who often need cybersecurity support which we do not provide in house. We would like to explore a referral partnership with SafeX Solutions. Ahmed

subject: What is the status of our project?
body: Hi team, just checking in on the mobile app milestone 2. Could you share where things stand and the updated delivery date? Grace

subject: Suspicious login attempts on our systems
body: We have detected repeated failed login attempts on our email server over the weekend and we are worried about a breach. Can your security team help us investigate urgently? Robert

subject: How much for social media management?
body: Assalam o alaikum, I want to know your monthly packages for social media management and SEO for a small boutique. JazakAllah

subject: Mobile app for iOS and Android
body: Hello, we are looking for a team to build a delivery tracking app for both iOS and Android. Do you handle this kind of work end to end including app store submission? James

subject: Login page not working for our users
body: Several of our users are reporting that they cannot log in to the portal. They get an invalid session error. Could someone take a look today? Emily

subject: Follow up on my earlier email
body: I sent an email last Tuesday about a quotation and have not received any reply. Please confirm whether you received it. Hassan

subject: Request for company profile
body: Hello, could you please send your company profile and portfolio of previous cybersecurity work? We are shortlisting vendors. Nina

subject: Need a quote for network security audit
body: Please provide a formal quotation for a network security audit covering roughly 60 endpoints and two servers. Oliver Grant

subject: Unhappy with the SEO results
body: It has been three months and our rankings have barely moved. I am not seeing value for the money we are paying. I want to discuss this. Meera

subject: Applying for developer role
body: Dear HR, I am a MERN stack developer with three years experience and would like to apply for any open frontend positions. My CV is attached. Bilal

subject: Meeting next Monday
body: Bonjour, can we arrange a video meeting next Monday at 11am CET to review the branding proposal? Chloe

subject: Payment method options
body: Hi, before we sign off on the contract could you confirm what payment methods you accept and whether you require an upfront deposit? Samuel

subject: Do you offer ongoing maintenance?
body: After the website launch, do you provide ongoing maintenance and support packages? What is included? Hannah

subject: Site loading very slowly
body: Our website has become extremely slow over the past few days, pages take 15 seconds to load. Customers are complaining. Please fix. Imran

subject: Ballpark budget for a custom platform
body: We need a custom SaaS platform with user dashboards and reporting. Roughly what budget range should we plan for? Rachel

subject: Ransomware concern
body: One of our staff opened a suspicious attachment and files on that machine now have strange extensions. We think it may be ransomware. Please advise urgently. Yusuf

subject: Interested in your creative media services
body: Hi there, we saw your photography and videography work. Could you tell us more about what your creative media team offers? Laura

subject: No response to my complaint
body: I raised an issue two weeks ago and nobody has gotten back to me. This is the third time I am writing. Very poor service. Ali

subject: Update on milestone 3
body: Could you confirm whether milestone 3 is still on track for the end of the month, and share a short progress summary? Sophie

subject: Reseller agreement discussion
body: We are interested in reselling your cybersecurity services under a white label arrangement in Eastern Europe. Who should I speak to? Dmitri

subject: Where are you located?
body: Salam, I wanted to know where your office is located and whether you work with clients outside Pakistan. Ayesha

subject: Quotation for annual security retainer
body: Please quote for a 12 month cybersecurity retainer including monitoring and quarterly assessments. Peter

subject: Checking in again about my application
body: Hello, I applied for the internship program last month and wanted to follow up on whether applications have been reviewed. Zainab

subject: Emails going to spam
body: Since the migration our outgoing emails are landing in customers spam folders. Can your team look at the DNS and SPF settings? Michael

subject: Cost of PPC campaign management
body: What do you charge to manage Google Ads campaigns monthly, and is the ad spend separate? Nadia

subject: Available for a discovery call?
body: Hi, I would like to set up an introductory call to discuss our requirements. What times work for your team next week? Ryan

subject: Contract and NDA copies
body: Could you please send over the standard contract and NDA templates so our legal team can review them before we proceed? Sana

subject: Refund for cancelled service
body: We cancelled the marketing retainer on the 10th but were still billed for the full month. Please arrange a partial refund. George

subject: Phishing emails targeting our staff
body: Our employees are receiving convincing phishing emails impersonating our CEO. We need help with awareness training and email security. Elena

subject: Timeline for the remaining deliverables
body: Can you share an updated project plan showing the remaining deliverables and dates? David

subject: Do you build custom web applications?
body: Hello, we need an internal inventory management web application. Is this something your team handles? Mariam
